DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与のお振込みについて、どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to ask about salary transfers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社へ出す口座の情報を確認したいです。「給与を振り込む」とだけ言いましたが、私が会社へ送金する話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与受取用の口座情報相談で自分から会社へ送金する依頼ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to check the account information to submit to my company. I only said ‘transfer my salary,’ but I do not mean that I will send money to the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are asking about account details for receiving your salary, not requesting to send money to your company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社から給与を受け取る口座についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are asking about the account into which you will receive your salary from the company, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。会社が送る側で、私が受け取る側です。自分の口座から誰かへ払う用紙を探していたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社が送金側本人が受取側で支払用紙は求めていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The company is the sender and I am the recipient. I was not looking for a form to pay someone from my own account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the company sends the money and you receive it, and that you are not asking for a payment form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出する情報を確認しましょう。会社の案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the details you need to submit. Do you have the company's instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。何を会社へ出すかを確認したいです。給与の支払日まで、銀行で決めてもらいたいという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社案内を示し提出情報を尋ね支払日決定は銀行へ求めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here they are. I want to check what to submit to the company. I do not mean that I want the bank to decide the salary payment date as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the company's instructions, ask what information to submit, and say that you are not asking the bank to decide the payment date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 口座の情報はこちらで確認し、会社の支払予定は会社へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check your account details here; please ask your company about its payment schedule.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。会社へ必要な欄を聞き、この口座の資料と照らし合わせます。まだ入金していない物を受取済みとも書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社要求欄を聞き口座資料と照合し未入金を受取済みとしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will ask the company which fields it needs and compare them with the documents for this account. I will not mark money that has not yet been deposited as received, either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask which fields the company requires, compare them with the account documents, and not mark an outstanding deposit as received. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の情報を確認してから、会社へ提出してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check your personal details before submitting them to the company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。受取り用の口座確認と支払予定を分け、送金の依頼として進めないよう用件を伝え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取口座確認と会社支払予定を分け送金依頼としないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will separate checking the receiving account from the payment schedule and explain my request again so it is not processed as a request to send money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will distinguish checking the receiving account from the company's payment schedule and avoid treating it as a money transfer request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を確認しました。それでは、口座情報の担当へご案内します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have confirmed your request. I will now direct you to the person responsible for account details. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: かごの品物を見直されているところですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you reviewing the items in your basket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族二人から頼まれた物を別々に取りました。同じ袋が二つあるので、同じ物を重ねて買おうとしているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族の二依頼を別々に取り同じ袋の重複購入かもしれないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I picked up items requested by two family members separately. There are two identical-looking bags, so I may be about to buy the same thing twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you picked up two family members' requests separately and may be buying duplicate bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見た目だけで決めず、品名や量を確認しましょう。どちらの品でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the product names and quantities rather than judging by appearance alone. Which items are they?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二つです。片方は大きい袋で、もう片方は小さい袋でした。同じ色なので、同じ商品で同じ量と思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二袋は同色だが大きさが違い同商品同量と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: These two. One was a large bag and the other a small one. Since they are the same color, I thought they were the same product in the same quantity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the bags are the same color but different sizes, and that you thought they were the same product and quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示はこちらです。同じ用途か、家族の希望も確認してからお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here are the labels. Please also check your family's wishes and whether they are for the same use before deciding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 聞いてみます。一人が朝食用、もう一人が別の料理用と言ったので、単に同じ注文を二回聞いたとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 朝食と別料理の用途を本人へ確かめ同一依頼と断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask them. One said it was for breakfast and the other for a different dish, so I will not assume that I simply heard the same request twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the family members about the breakfast and other cooking uses, without assuming they are the same request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な種類と数が分かってから、お会計へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please bring the items to the checkout once you know the types and numbers you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族に確認できました。朝食用の小さい品一つだけでよく、別の料理の分は家にあるそうです。まだ会計前なので見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小さい朝食品のみ必要で他用途分は在庫ありと未精算の見直しを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked with my family. We only need one small item for breakfast; apparently we already have the one for the other dish at home. I have not paid yet, so I will revise my selection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that only the small breakfast item is needed, that the item for the other use is already at home, and that you will revise the selection before paying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入しない品の扱いは、こちらへお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please let us know about any items you are not buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、大きい方はこちらへお渡しします。色ではなく品名と量、家にある物を確かめ、必要な一つだけ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入しない品を店員へ渡し品名と量と在庫で一品を選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will hand the larger one to you. I will check the product name, quantity, and what we have at home instead of the color, and buy only the one we need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand the unwanted item to the staff and choose one item based on its name, quantity, and stock at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望の品を確認しました。それでは、必要な一品でお会計いたします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have confirmed the item you want. We will ring up just that one item. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お歩きになる場所について、ご心配がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you worried about where you will be walking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 以前この公園で転びました。今日も同じ通路は必ず危ないと思って、入るのを迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 過去の転倒で同通路は今日も必ず危険と思い入園を迷うと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I fell in this park before. I am hesitating to go in because I think the same path must be dangerous today too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that a previous fall makes you think the same path must be dangerous today and leaves you hesitant to enter the park. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前の出来事を伺い、今日の通路の案内も確認しましょう。前はどちらで転ばれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us hear about what happened before and check today's path information too. Where did you fall?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 曲がり角の所です。あの日は雨でしたが、足元をよく見ていなかったので、転んだ原因を全部分かっているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 雨の日の曲がり角の転倒だが原因は全て不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the bend. It was raining that day, but I was not watching my footing carefully, so I do not know every reason why I fell.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you fell at a bend on a rainy day but do not know all the causes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の利用案内を確認できます。前に転んだというだけで、今日の全ての通路の状態は判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can check the current visitor information. A previous fall alone does not tell us the condition of every path today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。反対に今日は晴れているから安全、とも決めません。歩く経路を確認してから進みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 過去も晴天も安全判断の代わりにせず今の経路確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Conversely, I will not assume that it is safe just because it is sunny today. I would like to check my walking route before going ahead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the current route without treating past experience or sunny weather as a substitute for assessing safety. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望の方向はこちらの案内で確認しましょう。途中で休みたい場合の場所も伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check your intended direction on this guide. You can also ask about places to rest along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。急いで一周する予定ではないので、まず短い経路を確認し、途中で不安になったら立ち止まって相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一周を急がず短経路と休憩場所を聞き不安なら止まって相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I am not planning to hurry around the whole park, so I will check a short route first, and stop and ask for help if I feel uneasy along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not rush around the whole park, will ask about a short route and resting places, and will stop and consult someone if uneasy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 無理に進まず、ご自身のご様子に合わせてご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do not push yourself; use the park according to how you feel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。前の経験と今の案内を分けて考え、歩く場所を確認してから、ゆっくり散歩します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 過去の経験と現在案内を分け確認後ゆっくり歩くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will consider my past experience separately from the current information, check where I will walk, and then take a leisurely stroll.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will separate past experience from current guidance and walk slowly after checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望の経路をご確認ください。それでは、お気をつけてお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check your chosen route. Take care during your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 長いケースをお持ちですね。改札の通り方でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a long case. Are you having trouble getting through the ticket gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 楽器のケースです。横に持つと後ろの人へ当たりそうなので、通る前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長い楽器ケースが後ろへ当たりそうで改札前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is an instrument case. If I carry it sideways, it may hit the person behind me, so I want to ask before going through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice before the ticket gate because your long instrument case might hit someone behind you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ケースを立てた状態で、安全に持つことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you safely hold the case upright?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 立てて持てます。ただ、高くて前が見えにくくなります。急いで向きを変えると周りへ当たりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 立てられるが視界が狭まり急な向き変更が危険と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can hold it upright. However, it is tall and makes it hard to see ahead. If I change direction quickly, it might hit people around me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you can hold it upright, but it restricts your view and a sudden turn could be dangerous. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 係員が通れる経路を確認します。今は改札の脇でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: A staff member will check a route you can use. Please wait beside the ticket gate for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらへ寄ります。後ろの人に進んでもらい、ケースを振り回さず、案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 脇に寄り後続を通して振回さず待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will move over here. I will let the people behind me pass and wait for guidance without swinging the case around.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will move aside, let those behind pass, and wait without swinging the case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: このケース以外に、お荷物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have any luggage besides this case?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 背中に小さなリュックがあります。両手を使えるので、片手で引きずらず持って進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: リュック以外の荷物はなく両手で持てると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a small backpack on my back. My hands are both free, so I can carry it with both hands instead of dragging it with one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have no other luggage except a backpack and can hold the case with both hands. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通るときは係員の案内と、周りの人の位置をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you go through, please follow the staff member's guidance and check where the people around you are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。改札を通った後もすぐ横へ倒さず、広い所で向きを変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通過後も広い場所まで横向きに変えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Even after passing the gate, I will not immediately lower it sideways; I will change its orientation in a spacious area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not turn the case sideways after passing through until you reach a spacious place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 通れる場所を確認いたします。それでは、その位置で少々お待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check where you can pass. Please wait in that position for a moment. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 放送について、どんなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What difficulty are you having with the announcements?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の中では防災放送の最後しか聞こえません。聞き逃した内容を文字で確かめる方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 室内で聞き逃す防災放送を文字で確認したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Inside my house, I can only hear the end of the disaster prevention announcements. Is there a way to check the parts I missed in writing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about checking disaster prevention announcements in writing because you miss them indoors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつの放送で、どの部分が聞こえましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: When was the announcement, and which part could you hear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の昼頃です。「ご注意ください」だけ聞こえたので、何への注意か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日の昼に注意の言葉だけ聞こえ対象が不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around noon today. I only heard ‘please be careful,’ so I do not know what we should be careful about.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you heard only a caution around noon today and do not know what it concerned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 放送内容の確認先と、文字で情報を受け取れる案内を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the person in charge where to check the announcement's contents and about receiving information in writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。スマートフォンはありますが、音声を大きくするだけでは解決しないと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: スマートフォンはあるが音量変更だけでは不十分と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I have a smartphone, but I do not think simply turning up the sound will solve this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a smartphone but changing the volume alone is not enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 文字で見られる仕組みがあるか、設定も含めてご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can ask whether there is a system for viewing text, including how to set it up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族にも確認先を伝えたいです。同じ家でも聞こえ方が違うので、一人が聞いたつもりで済ませないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族間の聞こえ方も違うため確認先を共有したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to tell my family where to check too. Even in the same house, we hear differently, so we will not leave it at one person thinking they heard it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to share where to check because family members hear differently. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 登録が必要な場合は、受け取る地域や通知の種類を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: If registration is required, please check the area and types of notifications you will receive.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 地域を間違えないよう担当に見てもらいます。今日の放送内容も、登録の相談と分けて確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地域設定と今日の放送内容を別々に担当へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will have the person in charge check so I do not select the wrong area. I also want to check today's announcement separately from discussing registration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the person in charge to check the area setting and today's announcement separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つのご用件を担当へ伝えます。それでは、窓口でご相談ください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass both requests to the person in charge. Please discuss them at the counter. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計のほかに、確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check besides paying?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 診察では緊張して、家で続けている運動のことを聞き忘れました。受付で答えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察で運動の質問を忘れ受付へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was nervous during my consultation and forgot to ask about the exercises I do at home. Can the reception desk answer that?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask reception about an exercise question you forgot during your consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 運動を続けてよいかという判断は、受付ではできません。診療担当へ確認したい内容を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Reception cannot decide whether you may continue exercising. I will take the details of what you want to ask the medical professional.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。運動の名前だけでなく、一回の時間と、動くと気になるところをメモしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 運動の時間と気になる箇所もメモしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Besides the name of the exercise, I have noted how long each session lasts and the areas that bother me when I move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you also noted the duration of the exercise and the areas that concern you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのメモをもとに、担当へ質問を伝えましょう。今ここでお待ちになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us pass your question to the person in charge using that note. Can you wait here now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 少し待てます。ただ、今の状態を見てもらう必要があるなら、メモだけで返答を求めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待てるが診察が必要ならメモだけの回答を求めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can wait a little. However, if my current condition needs to be examined, I will not ask for an answer based on the note alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you can wait, but will not request an answer based only on the note if an examination is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 回答方法や再度の診察が必要かも、担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will also check how to respond and whether another consultation is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。帰った後に自分で判断せず、どう確認するかを聞いてから帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅前に担当へ確認する方法を知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I want to learn how to check this before going home, rather than deciding for myself after returning home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to know how to check with the medical professional before going home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご案内を聞いて、不明な点が残ったらお申し出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please listen to the guidance and let us know if anything remains unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 聞き忘れた運動の件と、回答を受ける方法の二つを確認します。今はメモを持って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 運動の件と回答方法を整理して待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check both the exercise issue I forgot to ask about and the way to receive an answer. For now, I will wait with my note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will organize the exercise question and the way to receive an answer, and wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へおつなぎします。それでは、こちらでお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the person in charge. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の映像をお持ちなのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought the video you want to discuss, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。車の記録映像ですが、画面の時刻が実際と違うことに気づきました。そのまま見せてよいか伺いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談映像の表示時刻が実際と違うと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is footage recorded in my car, but I noticed the time on the screen differs from the actual time. I want to ask if I can show it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the time displayed in the video you want to discuss differs from the actual time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 違いに気づいた経緯を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me how you noticed the discrepancy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝の出来事なのに、画面には夜の時刻が出ています。時計を以前直していなかったようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 朝の出来事に夜の表示が出て時計未調整と思うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It happened in the morning, but the screen shows a nighttime hour. It seems I had not corrected the clock previously.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that a morning event shows a nighttime time and you think the clock had not been adjusted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際の時刻について、分かる手がかりはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have any clues to the actual time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出発前に家族へ送ったメッセージは残っています。ただ、映像の何秒目が何時何分かまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出発前メッセージはあるが秒単位の対応は不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I still have a message I sent my family before leaving. However, I do not know which second in the video corresponds to which hour and minute.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have a message from before departure but do not know the correspondence down to the second. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示と実際の時刻が違うことを説明し、元の記録を保って担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Explain that the displayed time differs from the actual time, preserve the original recording, and consult the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示の数字を自分で書き換えて、正しい映像のようにはしません。元のファイルとメッセージを持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時計表示を編集せず元データと手がかりを保つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not rewrite the displayed numbers myself to make it look like accurately timed footage. I have the original file and the message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not edit the clock display and will preserve the original data and clues. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が必要な確認を行います。ほかに切り取った映像はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will make the necessary checks. Do you have any other excerpts of the footage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 短い部分を家族に送りましたが、元の長い記録も残しました。二つを区別して説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 短縮版と元の長い記録を両方残し区別すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I sent a short part to my family, but I also kept the original longer recording. I will distinguish the two when explaining.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you kept both the shortened version and the original long recording and will distinguish them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 時計の違いも含めて担当へ伝えます。それでは、確認の席へご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the person in charge about the clock discrepancy too. I will show you to the consultation area. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の表面について、気になるところがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something about the front of the envelope that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この封筒をもう一度使いたいのですが、前に書いた宛名が少し見えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再使用する封筒に旧宛名が残ると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to reuse this envelope, but the address written on it before is still slightly visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an old address remaining on an envelope you want to reuse. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい宛名は、もうお書きになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already written the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 旧宛名の上に紙を貼って書きました。でも、端から前の郵便番号が見えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 貼った紙の外から前の郵便番号が見えると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I stuck paper over the old address and wrote on it. But the previous postal code is visible at the edge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the old postal code is visible beyond the pasted paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どちらが宛先なのか迷う表示は避けたいですね。貼った部分も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We want to avoid markings that make the destination unclear. Let us also check the pasted area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 角が浮いています。上から何枚も貼り足すより、新しい封筒へ書き直そうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙の角も浮くため新しい封筒に替えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The corner is lifting. Instead of sticking on more and more layers, I think I will rewrite the address on a new envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will use a new envelope because the paper's corner is also lifting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中の書類と新しい宛先を、ご自身で照合してから封をしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please personally compare the documents inside with the new destination before sealing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。書類は一通で、宛先は会社の担当部署です。前の送り先と取り違えないよう別に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類と会社部署の宛先を照合し旧封筒を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. There is one document, and the destination is the relevant department at the company. I will put the old envelope separately so I do not confuse it with the previous destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the document against the company department's address and keep the old envelope separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 封筒の準備後、送り方をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once the envelope is ready, we can explain the sending methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に宛名を書き直します。古い封筒は発送用に戻さず、机の整理に使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名を書き直し古い封筒は発送に使わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will rewrite the address first. I will not put the old envelope back among those for posting; I will use it to organize my desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will rewrite the address and will not use the old envelope for posting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備ができましたらお声がけください。それでは、記入台をご利用ください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please let us know when you are ready. You may use the writing counter. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今鳴った音は、お客様のお持ちの端末からでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did that sound just come from your device?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、私の携帯です。家の用事のアラームを止め忘れました。銀行の警報ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯の私用アラームで施設警報ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, it is my phone. I forgot to turn off an alarm for something at home. It is not the bank's alarm.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that it is a personal phone alarm, not a facility alarm. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今、音を止められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Can you stop the sound now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 止めました。通知音と違う大きな音だったので、近くの方も驚かれたと思います。すみません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 停止済みで大きな音が周囲を驚かせたと謝る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have stopped it. It was a loud sound unlike my notification tone, so I think it startled the people nearby. I am sorry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Apologize, saying that you have stopped the loud sound that startled those nearby. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 周囲へは係からお伝えします。これから同じアラームがまた鳴る設定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Our staff will explain to those nearby. Is this alarm set to sound again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五分後にもう一度鳴る設定でした。音を一回止めるだけでなく、今日はその繰返しも解除します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 五分後の繰返し設定も解除すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was set to sound again in five minutes. Besides stopping it once, I will disable its repeat setting for today too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will also disable the repeat alarm set for five minutes later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 設定はご自身で確認してください。窓口のお呼出しも聞こえるようになさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the settings yourself. Make sure you can also hear when you are called to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。イヤホンで塞ぐのでなく、端末の設定を変えます。番号札は手元にあって、まだ呼ばれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 耳を塞がず設定を変え番号の呼出しを待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will change the device settings instead of blocking my ears with earphones. I have my numbered ticket with me, and I have not been called yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will change the settings without blocking your ears and wait for your number to be called. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご用件の順番まで、待合のお席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait in the seating area until it is your turn.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 解除を確認しました。この音を職員が案内したものとして、周りへ説明することはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 解除を確認し音を職員の案内として説明しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed it is disabled. I will not explain to people around me that the sound was an announcement made by the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have confirmed it is disabled and will not describe the sound as a staff announcement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご対応ありがとうございます。それでは、お席でお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for dealing with it. Please wait in your seat. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 回収箱へ入れる食品について、ご確認ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking about food to put in the collection box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この缶詰を寄付したいです。棚から取ってすぐ箱へ入れれば、寄付の扱いになると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚から取った缶詰を未会計で寄付箱へ入れてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to donate this canned food. I thought that taking it from the shelf and immediately placing it in the box would count as a donation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may put canned food taken from the shelf into the donation box without paying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 売場の商品は先にお会計が必要です。今はまだ箱へ入れていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You need to pay for merchandise first. You have not put it in the box yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。寄付する物でも、買う前は自分の物ではありませんね。まずレジへ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未投入で先に購入が必要と理解しレジへ持つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. Even if I intend to donate it, it is not mine before I buy it. I will take it to the checkout first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not put it in, understand you must buy it first, and will take it to the checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 寄付の対象条件も、箱の案内でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check the instructions on the box for donation eligibility requirements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 未開封と残りの期限について書かれています。買えば必ず寄付できるとは思わず、この缶詰が対象か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封と期限の条件を読み商品が対象か確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: They mention unopened items and remaining shelf life. I do not assume that anything I buy can definitely be donated; I want to check whether this canned food qualifies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the unopened-item and shelf-life conditions and ask whether the item qualifies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が案内を確認します。ご自宅からお持ちの食品もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the instructions. Do you also have food brought from home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日はありません。かごには夕食用の缶詰もあるので、寄付する分は一つと分けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参食品はなく夕食用と寄付一つを分けると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not today. There is also canned food for dinner in my basket, so I will keep the single donation item separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought no food from home and will separate the dinner items from the one donation item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対象の確認ができたら、購入後に回収箱をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once eligibility is confirmed, please use the collection box after purchasing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。対象を聞き、会計を済ませてから一つだけ入れます。夕食用までまとめて入れないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象確認と会計後に寄付分だけ箱へ入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will ask whether it qualifies, pay, and then put just one in. I will make sure not to put the dinner items in along with it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after checking eligibility and paying, you will put only the donation item in the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ対象の確認をお願いします。それでは、かごに入れたままお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please have the person in charge check eligibility. For now, wait with it still in your basket. Excuse me.
